title: Karaoke and Music
blurb: Shower singers, guilty playlists and a dare or two to sing for. Mics optional.

dare: Sing the first line of any song as if you're an opera star.
Lip sync the chorus of a song the group picks.
Hum a song and make the group guess it within 15 seconds.
Rap the alphabet, with your own beat and flourishes.
Do air guitar for 20 seconds as if you're headlining a festival.
Perform an interpretive dance to the last song you listened to.
Sing a song of your choice entirely in the voice of a cartoon character.
Sing the chorus of a song using only the word 'meow'.
Perform the lead-in to your favourite song as a radio host.
Create a jingle for the person on your right in 20 seconds.
Sing happy birthday in the style of three different genres.
Do a drum solo on your lap or the table for 15 seconds.
Sing a verse of a nursery rhyme as a heavy metal singer.
Sing one line of any song as slowly as you can, ending on a big dramatic pose.
Invent a boy-band or girl-group dance routine in 20 seconds.
Sing a pop song in your best slow ballad voice.
Perform a one-line rap about the last thing you ate.
Sing your name to the tune of a well-known song.
Introduce your fake band to the room with a ridiculous backstory.
Perform a dramatic piano solo on an invisible keyboard.
Mime being a rock star smashing a guitar, gently.

Sing the national anthem in the style of a lounge singer.
